instruction: List the top botanists with the most species named after them.

List all works of art, including films and animated films.

query:
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>
PREFIX hint: <http://www.bigdata.com/queryHints#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?station ?stationLabel ?picture (SAMPLE(?pictureCategory) AS ?pictureCategory) WHERE {
hint:Query hint:optimizer "None".
# get metro stations in germany
?station wdt:P31 wd:Q928830 ;
wdt:P17 wd:Q183 .
# and pictures of them
?station wdt:P18 ?picture .
# build commons urls

bd:serviceParam mwapi:titles ?file.
?pictureCategory wikibase:apiOutput mwapi:category.

# and only get those with a Public Domain category
FILTER(STRSTARTS(?pictureCategory, "Category:PD-"))
SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "de,[AUTO_LANGUAGE]". }

ontolex:sense ?sense.

instruction: What day of the week did most prisoners die in Mauthausen concentration camp?
query:
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT ?weekday (count(distinct(?item)) as ?count) WHERE {
wd:Q362 wdt:P580 ?od ; wdt:P582 ?do.
?item wdt:P20 wd:Q160139 .
?item p:P570 [ps:P570 ?date ; psv:P570/wikibase:timePrecision ?precision ] filter(?precision = 11 && day(?date) != 1 && ?date > ?od && ?date < ?do ).
BIND( DAY( ?date ) AS ?q ) .
BIND( MONTH( ?date ) + IF( MONTH( ?date ) < 3, 12, 0 ) AS ?m ) .
BIND( YEAR( ?date ) - IF( MONTH( ?date ) < 3, 1, 0 ) AS ?_year ) .
BIND( ?_year - FLOOR( ?_year / 100 ) * 100 AS ?K ) . # modulo
BIND( FLOOR( YEAR( ?date ) / 100 ) AS ?J ) .
BIND( ?q + FLOOR( 13 * ( ?m + 1 ) / 5 ) + ?K + FLOOR( ?K / 4 ) + FLOOR( ?J / 4 ) - 2 * ?J AS ?_h ) .
BIND(( ?_h - FLOOR( ?_h / 7 ) * 7) as ?day) .
BIND(if(?day=0,"06 (Saturday)",if(?day=1,"07 (Sunday)",if(?day=2,"01 (Monday)",if(?day=3,"02 (Tuesday)",if(?day=4,"03 (Wednesday)",if(?day=5,"04 (Thursday)",if(?day=6,"05 (Friday)",""))))))) as ?weekday) .
} group by ?weekday order by asc(?weekday)
